query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

messages.content: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

message.content:
In Massachusetts, the **current maximum weekly unemployment benefit** is **$1,105 per week**, and you can receive it for **up to 30 weeks** if you qualify.[3][5]

A few details matter:
- Your actual weekly benefit is usually about **50% of your average weekly wage**, capped at the state maximum.[5]
- Massachusetts also says a claim can be open for **1 year (52 weeks)**, but the **benefit duration** is still limited to **up to 30 weeks** of payments.[5]

If you meant the **total maximum** you could collect over a full claim at the top weekly rate, that would be **$33,150** before any offsets or eligibility changes (\$1,105 × 30 weeks).[3][5]
